verdict.rationale: The platform offers stakeholders a 'My Equity' self-service view of their grants and exercise options, and a smart-linked data room that automatically shares relevant documents, which could reduce founder-investor emailing about holdings. However, there is no explicit evidence of a dedicated investor-facing portal (distinct from employee/optionholder equity view) or of proactive 'structured updates' (e.g., scheduled reports, dashboards) being pushed to investors. Missing for 10: dedicated investor portal distinct from employee equity view, evidence of structured/periodic investor update delivery, and any investor-specific reporting feature.
